text_chunks.text: The sample project is small and deliberately boring:
a two-function app.py, a two-function utils.py, and a plain static page under web/.
Nothing in it does anything useful on its own -- its README says so directly.
That is consistent with what the file listing and both reads actually showed: no hidden dependencies, no build step, no network calls anywhere in this project.

proposals: The sample project ships with Point's Demo mode and is deliberately minimal -- two tiny modules and a static page.
Nothing in the sample project performs network calls or has a build step.
